<h3>👁️ מעקב עיניים במצלמה — בשביל התאמה: 👁️ Camera eye tracking — for a better fit
<p>כשהאפשרות פועלת, המצלמה של המחשב או ה: When it is on, the computer or phone camera helps the app understand how you actually read, not only what you choose in the test flight:
<li><b>📏 מרחק מהמסך</b>: מחושב לפי גודל: • 📏 Distance from the screen: estimated from the size of the iris (the colored part of the eye). Letter size then matches what the eye sees, even when sitting close or far.
<li><b>🔍 התקרבות למסך</b>: מי שמתקרב תוך: • 🔍 Leaning in: someone who moves closer while reading probably needs bigger letters. The app will offer to enlarge them.
<li><b>🎯 מבט למרכז</b>: בכיול ובבדיקת תי: • 🎯 Looking at the center: during calibration and the distortion test it matters to look at the middle point. The camera notices when the gaze moves and asks to return to the center.
<li><b>😴 עייפות ומאמץ</b>: מצמוצים רבים: • 😴 Tiredness and effort: lots of blinking or squinting. This tells when to take a break, and when test flight results are less reliable.
